app_group_bootstrap.unit: APP, cases within app sampled together, not independent individual screenshots

limitations: Retained unused subset is disjoint by record id but original source app identities overlap with prior first round. Thresholds were fixed by prior round, not tuned to these gold labels.
Author right controls are byte-identical to source-approved screenshot in same viewport, not naturally changed app states.
Real clean portrait and landscape screenshots intentionally have different layouts; forced wrong-state comparison demonstrates source version/input mismatch, not an acceptable detector.
Opposite viewport correct gate must abstain; app semantics under a different viewport require its own approved reference.
Synthetic bug annotations are not an independent human evaluation of real-world objectionability or precise region quality.
No human-gold natural video temporal faults or real owner final render quality scores, and live SWAAG integration remains unverified.

negative_control.wrong_viewport_control_does_not_match_st: portrait->landscape originals of same activity are author approved but should not be matched to wrong viewport. Forced resize comparator deliberately violates contract, NOT a legitimate correctly bound false positive.

original_gold_status: Author release labels distinguish originally right screens from seeded mutants; NOT independent human acceptance ratings; no pixel-level blame regions/visible severity ground truth, no actual owner output independent gold.

resources.initial_failure: An initial 110.781 s source acquisition phase downloaded original PNGs but stopped when an author-referenced clean image was HTTP 404, before any predictions were frozen. Subsequent resumption used cached unchanged original bytes and abstained on missing source references.
resources.unknown_latency: Live end-to-end SWAAG tool-call latency absent; numbers are batch wall time on busy Nitro CPU, both methods share image decoding; forced viewport comparisons consume additional processing.
